nbaInjuries.name: Anthony Edwards
nbaInjuries.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

nbaInjuries.name: Paolo Banchero
nbaInjuries.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Anthony Davis
nbaInjuries.note: Davis (ankle) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Thunder.

nbaInjuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
nbaInjuries.note: Haliburton (hamstring) is progressing well but does not have a timetable to return, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Brandon Ingram
nbaInjuries.note: Ingram (Achilles) has progressed to full contact basketball activities, per NBA writer Justin Russo.

nbaInjuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
nbaInjuries.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

nbaInjuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
nbaInjuries.note: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN re

nbaInjuries.name: Jalen Johnson
nbaInjuries.note: Johnson (ankle) is probable for Saturday's game against Brooklyn.

nbaInjuries.name: Desmond Bane
nbaInjuries.note: Bane (illness) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Warriors.

nbaInjuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
nbaInjuries.note: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
